harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node2's port-8080 HTTP service through node1 to TCP/80 on node1's management address, keeping the service bound only to a new private link between node1 and node2. Then performed the mandatory sequential restart of all three nodes with pre/post evidence.
actions_performed: Surveyed node1 (OpenWrt), node2 (RHEL9), node3 (RHEL9): found node1 eth1 and node2 enp8s0 as unused NICs intended as the private link (all three nodes also share a 10.100.57.0/24 management network via br-lan/enp1s0)
Configured static IPs on the private link: node1 eth1=192.168.50.1/24 via UCI network.priv interface; node2 enp8s0=192.168.50.2/24 via nmcli (never-default so it doesn't affect routing)
Verified node1<->node2 private-link ping works and node3 has no route to 192.168.50.0/24 (only via its default gateway, unreachable)
Created and enabled a systemd unit (node2-http.service) running python3 http.server bound explicitly to 192.168.50.2:8080, serving /srv/www/index.html; opened firewalld port 8080/tcp on node2

Added OpenWrt firewall zone 'priv' (network=priv, masq=1) and a DNAT redirect (src=lan, src_dport=80 -> dest=priv, dest_ip=192.168.50.2, dest_port=8080) on node1, committed and reloaded; masq on the priv zone avoids the asymmetric-routing issue since node2 also sits on the management subnet

Verified end-to-end from node3: curl http://10.100.57.10:80/index.html returns 200 with node2's content, while direct access to node2 (10.100.57.11:8080) from node3 fails, confirming the service stays private
Captured baseline boot_id on all three nodes, then restarted node1 (reboot), node2 (systemctl reboot), and node3 (systemctl reboot) one at a time, polling each until exec access returned
After each restart, confirmed changed boot_id and re-verified interface config, firewall config, service state, and full end-to-end publish path

evidence.requirement: node2 HTTP service on 8080 bound to the private network only
evidence.summary: systemd unit node2-http.service listens only on 192.168.50.2:8080; direct curl from node3 to node2's management IP:8080 returns 000 (unreachable)

evidence.requirement: Private link between node1 and node2 established and isolated from node3
evidence.summary: node1 eth1=192.168.50.1/24 and node2 enp8s0=192.168.50.2/24 configured; ping succeeds between them; node3 ping to 192.168.50.2 fails (100% loss, no direct route)

evidence.requirement: node3 can reach the service via node1's management address on port 80
evidence.summary: OpenWrt DNAT redirect (lan:80 -> priv 192.168.50.2:8080) configured via UCI/firewall; curl from node3 to http://10.100.57.10:80/index.html returns HTTP 200 with node2's content

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id cff8c13b...; reboot acknowledged (SSH closed); post-restart boot_id 0b2b9689... (changed) with uptime 0m; private interface, UCI network/firewall config, and end-to-end curl from node3 all confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 55595e92...; systemctl reboot acknowledged (stream closed); post-restart boot_id 19fadfd5... (changed) with fresh boot time; private IP, node2-http.service active, firewalld port, and end-to-end curl from node3 all confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 9feeb0bb...; systemctl reboot acknowledged (stream closed); post-restart boot_id de43de47... (changed) with fresh boot time; publish path re-verified working and direct node2 access still blocked from node3

attempts.summary: Published node2's port-8080 HTTP service through node1 to TCP/80 on node1's management address, keeping the service bound only to a new private link between node1 and node2. Then performed the mandatory sequential restart of all three nodes with pre/post evidence.
